extracted.intended_audience: UNC Chapel Hill faculty, researchers, and research staff seeking support for proposal development and funding
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and services provided by a university research development office to increase competitiveness of external funding proposals, form multidisciplinary teams, manage limited submissions, and develop partnerships with sponsors. Focused on planning large-scale interdisciplinary proposals, grantsmanship training, and internal pilot funding to position projects for external awards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Enhance complex proposal competitiveness
rubrics_metrics.description: The Office exists to expand UNC’s capacity for innovative, groundbreaking research by providing resources that enhance complex proposal competitiveness.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide resources (consultation, workshops, pilot funds, team formation) aimed specifically at improving the competitiveness of complex, multi-investigator or interdisciplinary proposals submitted to external sponsors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Foster collaboration across campus and with external partners
rubrics_metrics.description: Fosters collaboration across the research community within Carolina and among key partners.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Encourage and enable cross-departmental and cross-institutional collaborations that strengthen proposals; facilitate partnerships with regional, national, and international entities to increase project reach and sponsor appeal.

rubrics_metrics.name: Facilitate project ideation, resource identification, and team formation
rubrics_metrics.description: The Office facilitates project ideation, resource identification, and multidisciplinary team formation to enhance UNC’s competitiveness in securing funding for research and scholarly projects.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assist researchers in generating ideas, mapping required resources (personnel, facilities, budgets), and assembling complementary multidisciplinary teams tailored to address specific funding opportunities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Form teams to address 'grand challenge' questions
rubrics_metrics.description: Fosters collaborations among researchers to form teams that can address 'grand challenge' questions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prioritize assembling teams and shaping proposals around large-scale, societally relevant problems ('grand challenges') that align with sponsor priorities and have interdisciplinary scope.

rubrics_metrics.name: Convene thematic workshops around university and sponsor-specific research themes
rubrics_metrics.description: Convenes thematic workshops around university and sponsor-specific research themes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use workshops to build communities of interest, refine research questions, and align campus expertise to sponsor priorities; workshops serve as a mechanism for ideation and team-building.

rubrics_metrics.name: Consult on strategies for pursuing specific funds
rubrics_metrics.description: Consults with researchers on the best strategies for pursuing funds for specific projects.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide one-on-one strategic advice about target sponsors, fit, proposal framing, consortium roles, and submission approaches tailored to a given project and funding opportunity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide internal pan-university pilot funding opportunities
rubrics_metrics.description: Provides internal pan-university pilot funding opportunities to enable research teams to better pursue external funding: funds for idea development and team building, interdisciplinary 'grand challenge' awards, and targeted funding for fine arts and humanities scholars and researchers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Offer small-scale internal awards to de-risk proposals, support preliminary data/activities, build teams, and position projects to be more competitive for external awards; include mechanisms for arts & humanities and interdisciplinary efforts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Support planning and submission of large-scale interdisciplinary proposals
rubrics_metrics.description: Support the planning and submission of large-scale proposals focused on interdisciplinary convergence science projects.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide structured assistance (project management, proposal writing support, budgets, compliance coordination) for complex, multi-institutional, or large-budget proposals that require integration across disciplines.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide grantsmanship training to faculty investigators of all levels
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide grantsmanship training to faculty investigators of all levels to provide building blocks for successful, first-time submissions to new sponsors.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Deliver trainings and materials on proposal-writing skills, sponsor expectations, and submission processes aimed at early-career and experienced investigators preparing applications to unfamiliar sponsors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Identify, track, and disseminate strategic external funding opportunities
rubrics_metrics.description: Identifies, tracks and disseminates strategic external research funding opportunities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Actively monitor sponsor announcements and translate them into targeted opportunities communicated to relevant researchers and units, including timing and fit guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Manage limited submission processes to advance top candidates
rubrics_metrics.description: Manages limited submission grants and awards to ensure that UNC advances top candidates in these competitions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Administer internal competitions and selection processes when sponsors restrict the number of institutional nominees, including coordinating deadlines, reviews, and campus selection to present the strongest applicants.

rubrics_metrics.name: Promote national and international recognition of faculty
rubrics_metrics.description: Promotes national and international recognition of UNC faculty.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Support faculty visibility and reputation-building activities (e.g., nomination support, publicity, networking) to increase competitiveness for prestigious awards and external partnerships.

rubrics_metrics.name: Coordinate campus visits and relationships with program officers and national labs
rubrics_metrics.description: Promotes UNC’s relationship with federal funding sponsors and partners: coordinates campus visits and facilitates relationships among researchers, program officers, and national laboratories.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Facilitate interactions between UNC researchers and sponsor representatives (e.g., site visits, meetings) to build relationships, clarify priorities, and improve proposal alignment with sponsor goals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Encourage participation in federal advisory roles
rubrics_metrics.description: Encourages participation of UNC researchers in advisory roles to serve federal partners through Federal Advisory Committee nominations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Support nomination and preparation of faculty for service on federal advisory committees, which can strengthen institutional-sponsor ties and faculty prominence.

rubrics_metrics.name: Collaborate with UNC System schools and other North Carolina campuses
rubrics_metrics.description: Collaborates with UNC System schools and other North Carolina campuses.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Engage in multi-campus collaboration and resource-sharing across the UNC System and state institutions to leverage regional strengths and form broader consortia for funding opportunities.
